description: 2024 NCFO Terminals Operators Supplement is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Maritime and Waterways", published or maintained by USDOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. This supplemental file is used to generate the Terminal Summary File. It contains operator responses form the terminal where available. These are aggregated to create a single response per terminal in the case where there are multiple operators per ferry terminal. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Maritime and Waterways". It has 21 columns, among them INTERCITY_BUS, IN_OPERATION, TERMINAL_ID, BIKE_SHARE, TERMINAL_COMPLETED, TERMINAL_OPERATED_BY. The portal shows 2026-06-11 as the last data update. Attribution given: USDOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
